subject: Seat swap & rollover plan for exec workshop travel
messages:
From: Aurelia Travel <ops@aureliatravel.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@globex.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec workshop — bulkhead seats & oversized gear

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Quick note as we're finalizing the group reservation for the 25 May on AA 126 / 129 into SFO for the Globex exec workshop. Two items that need a decision ASAP before we ticket the group: 

1) Bulkhead / extra-legroom seats: we have 4 bulkhead / exit-row seats available on AA 126. Vivek Kulkarni has a VIP request for extra legroom; would you like us to assign him one of the bulkhead seats and charge to the company card?

2) Oversized demo equipment: Attendee Marcus Lin (listed on the attached guest_manifest.xlsx) is bringing a demo case that exceeds carry-on. Airline will allow it as checked oversize at $150 each, but inventory is limited on AA 126 — if that sells out we need to roll Marcus to AA 129 departing +3h later.

We can hold seats and tentative PNRs for 48 hours. Attached: seat_map_bulkhead.pdf (seat map with available rows) and a stubbed PNR list (PNR_AA126-stubs.txt).

Options for you:
- Approve bulkhead for Vivek and confirm company to cover oversize fee (we will invoice Redwood), OR
- If no approval, we will assign standard seats and attempt to keep Marcus on AA 126 but cannot guarantee.

Please reply with final seat assignment preferences and whether you want Aurelia to bill the oversize fees to Redwood or collect on-site. If you need us to hold off ticketing until headcount confirmed, say so and we'll keep the tentatives.

Thanks — we can hop on a 10-minute call if easier.

Best,
Clara Mendoza
Operations Lead, Aurelia Travel
ops@aureliatravel.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: guest_manifest.xlsx, seat_map_bulkhead.pdf, PNR_AA126-stubs.txt
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aurelia Travel <ops@aureliatravel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — bulkhead seats & oversized gear

Clara — thanks for the heads-up. Quick answers below.

1) Bulkhead: please assign one bulkhead seat to Vivek Kulkarni (he's OK with a window or aisle). Assign remaining bulkhead seats to Marissa Cole and Laura Bennett (if available).

2) Oversize demo: approved to bill to Redwood for Marcus Lin's oversize case. Please invoice Aurelia / forward invoice to finance@redwood.ai — I will confirm PO in a follow-up. Note: per Redwood_travel_policy_v2.pdf (attached), the company will cover one oversize/oversize bag for demo purposes when pre-approved.

Hold ticketing until EOD today (17 May) if possible — we are finalizing a late addition (Tom Hargreaves asked for an extra local host to join). If you need the final headcount earlier, ping me directly.

Also, please note: Tom Hargreaves from Globex has asked that two of our team arrive earlier for a prep walk-through on the 24th. If Marcus must be rolled to AA 129, we may need an alternate plan to get his kit to the venue (courier or ship). Please outline courier cost estimate if rollover occurs.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0124

Attachment: redwood_travel_policy_v2.pdf
From: Aurelia Travel <ops@aureliatravel.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — bulkhead seats & oversized gear

Neha / team — thanks, will proceed as requested. Summary of actions we took this morning: 

- Assigned bulkhead seats: Vivek Kulkarni (12A), Marissa Cole (12B), Laura Bennett (12C). Seats held and will be ticketed.
- Marcus Lin's oversize bag: hold placed, fee $150. We will bill Aurelia's invoice to Redwood (link below). Please confirm PO number to finalize billing.
- Rollover contingency: AA 126 is currently at high load; if the oversize allowance sells out, Marcus' booking will be moved to AA 129 (dep +3:15). In that case we will do one of the following based on your preference:
  a) Ship the demo case via same-day courier to Globex for an estimated $420 (door-to-door, includes insurance), OR
  b) Rebook Marcus on the earliest available redeye arriving before the 24th (if available).

Current tentative PNR stubs are attached (PNR_AA126-stubs.txt). We can ticket tonight at 5pm PT if you confirm the PO for billing and give us the green light. 

Invoice link: https://aureliatravel.com/invoice/INV-78945

--
Clara Mendoza
Aurelia Travel

Neha — thanks for flagging the early walkthrough. I will coordinate who takes the 24th slot and update the guest_manifest.xlsx with final names tonight.
